app.name: QuantLab
chat.banner: Research assistant — does not send orders
guided_lab.intro: Flow: venue → scan → strategy → simulate. LIVE only after username/password (human gate). Without unlock = blocked.
guided_lab.unlock.title: 0. Unlock LIVE (optional)
guided_lab.unlock.hint: Set QUANTLAB_LIVE_USER / QUANTLAB_LIVE_PASSWORD on your machine. Never stored in git or session disk.
guided_lab.a3.footer: A3 = PaperBroker (no venue routing). MD env: QUANTLAB_A3_MD_READONLY=1 + creds.
guided_lab.demo.hint: Binance demo fill. Requires unlock. Default: local sim. Remote testnet only with QUANTLAB_DEMO_USE_TESTNET=1 + keys.

tip.gl.unlock:
Validate local LIVE user/password.
Without unlock, demo stays blocked.
tip.gl.lock:
Return to LIVE_BLOCKED.
Cuts demo path until unlock again.
tip.gl.a3_status:
Query A3 MD status (fake/env).
Read-only; no orders.
tip.gl.a3_connect:
Connect A3 PaperBroker in this session.
No real venue routing.
tip.gl.a3_instr:
List instruments available on A3.
Useful before snapshot.
tip.gl.a3_snap:
Take an MD snapshot for the chosen symbol.
Read-only.
tip.gl.a3_paper:
Submit a paper order via A3.
No real exchange routing.
tip.gl.scan_lab:
Scan the local synthetic lab.
No external network.
tip.gl.scan_bn:
Scan USDT pairs via public Binance MD.
Read-only; no trading API.
tip.gl.scan_alpha:
Alpha ranking with Binance klines.
Orders research candidates.
tip.gl.pipeline:
Pipeline: ranking → backtest top 5.
Strategy below; no live orders.
tip.gl.run:
Simulate a paper backtest with the chosen strategy.
Does not send venue orders.
tip.gl.demo_submit:
Submit demo order after unlock.
Default: local sim; testnet only with flag+keys.
tip.gl.demo_cancel:
Cancel a demo order by order_id.
Requires active unlock.
tip.gl.demo_open:
List open demo orders.
Only after unlock.
